The Indian Women’s Hockey Team took on Germany in their concluding clash at the FIH Hockey World Cup Belgium & Netherlands 2026, securing a memorable 3–1 victory to finish 5th at the tournament.
India delivered a commanding performance against World No. 5 Germany, capping off their campaign with their best-ever World Cup finish in 52 years.
Watch the highlights from the India vs Germany clash as the Indian Women’s Team signed off a historic campaign in style.
